principle: Motion and transitions are presentation-layer effects only. They must not change the audio-driven timeline duration.

scene_transition.apply_when: background_image changes between consecutive timeline events

background_motion.direction_policy: run 1: 100% -> 80%; next background run: 80% -> 100%; alternate thereafter
background_motion.implementation: render each complete background run once, then slice that run for timeline events
background_motion.note: Percent means centered crop-window size, not image scale. 100% -> 80% is a centered zoom-in equivalent to scale 1.00 -> 1.25; 80% -> 100% is the reverse. Rendering once per background run prevents per-event zoom resets/jitter.

content_overlay.note: Only the newly revealed content line fades in; previously revealed lines remain fully visible.

explanation_overlay.note: Explanation fades in at the explanation event start and fades out before that event ends.
